items.headline: FDA approves first-ever treatment for symptomatic dermographism, a common form of chronic hives
items.summary: The FDA approved remibrutinib, sold as Rhapsido, as the first drug cleared specifically for symptomatic dermographism, a condition where hives appear within minutes of ordinary skin friction or scratching. In the trial behind the approval, nearly a third of patients saw their hives clear completely after twelve weeks, compared to about one in seven on placebo.
items.why_it_matters: The condition affects an estimated two to five percent of Americans and previously had no approved medical treatment beyond antihistamines.
